name: io.github.jasonstockman/warm-mcp
title: Warm
description: Read-only MCP server for Warm financial data via local stdio transport, with optional Streamable HTTP mode.

environmentVariables.name: WARM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Warm API key from https://warm.io/settings. If omitted, Warm MCP reads the local stored key or WARM_API_KEY_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: WARM_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a file that contains the Warm API key.

environmentVariables.name: WARM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Warm API base URL override.

environmentVariables.name: WARM_API_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Optional request timeout override in milliseconds.
